source: Good Sam directory (PUBLIC_PARK and local-named rows with no entry within 2 km) and every named OSM tourism=camp_site/caravan_site with no entry within 1.5 km, read by name
note: Three local adds (Vanderburgh County's Burdette Park, the county-run former Bass Lake State Beach, Earl Park's town campground) and one state miss, Shakamak State Park (128 electric sites). Excluded: Muncie's Prairie Creek (now primitive-only), Montgomery Ruritan (seasonal-dominated), fairgrounds, Camp Atterbury. Glendale FWA's campground is logged for a state check.
